text: Who are the leading luxury real estate agencies and top-performing auctioneers for prestige residential properties in Perth?

result.keyword: Who are the leading luxury real estate agencies and top-performing auctioneers for prestige residential properties in Perth?

items.markdown:
Leading luxury real estate agencies in Perth specializing in prestige residential properties across the western suburbs and riverside enclaves include `William Porteous Properties International, Christie's International Real Estate WA & SA, Acton | Belle Property Dalkeith / Cottesloe, Fine & Country Perth, and DUET Property Group`.[[1]](https://christiesrealestatewasa.com/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdkMlptZDRNbmRxGAo)

### Leading Luxury Real Estate Agencies

- **William Porteous Properties International** : Long-established authority handling ultra-prime properties and historic estates in Dalkeith, Mosman Park, and Peppermint Grove.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdkMlptZDRNbmRxGAo)
- **Christie's International Real Estate WA & SA** : High-end global affiliate with a Perth headquarters, connecting local prestige properties to an international luxury network.[[1]](https://www.christiesrealestate.com/de/network/christies-international-real-estate-western-australia-and-south-australia/182/)[[2]](https://christiesrealestatewasa.com/)
- **Acton | Belle Property (Dalkeith / Cottesloe)** : Dominant premium footprint throughout Perth’s affluent river and coastal corridors.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdkMlptZDRNbmRxGAo)
- **Fine & Country Perth** : International brokerage located on Stirling Highway in Cottesloe, tailored to high-net-worth global marketing.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdkMlptZDRNbmRxGAo)
- **DUET Property Group** : Boutique agency focusing on high-end architectural and luxury residential transactions in Nedlands and surrounding golden triangle suburbs.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdkMlptZDRNbmRxGAo)

### Top-Performing Prestige Specialists & Auctioneers

- **Peter Robertson** : Highly regarded luxury specialist and elite performer based in Dalkeith, renowned for handling landmark residential transactions.
- **Jody Fewster** : Consistently high-performing western suburbs agent specializing in premium coastal properties from Cottesloe down to Dalkeith.
- **Ray White (Dalkeith / Claremont / Cottesloe groups)** : Frequently manages high-volume prestige auction campaigns and high-value competitive bidding environments across the western suburbs.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdkMlptZDRNbmRxGAo)
